title: Recording with Girard and Melancholy Rhapsody
summary: He recorded three tunes with Girard on a Good Time Jazz session under Doc Souchon and recalls Girard's Melancholy Rhapsody record.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Well, George, certainly one thing that people used to talk about with him was his drive, too, the musicians. He played with tremendous drive.
Yeah. He played with tremendous drive.
I only caught one recording with George, and I was on Good Time Jazz label. And the late Doc Souchon was in charge of that recording session.
Yeah, we have it here. I played it the other day.

And there was, I think, four bands on that recording. And we only played three tunes. Dr. Jazz, Sand, and Liebestrown. We played those three numbers. But it was a pleasure working with George at that famous tour every night. I really enjoyed it. Well, he had a hit with Liebestrown, didn't he?
I think at one point he had a single out, but somebody did at that point.
I know. He featured that kind of trumpet that he played. He played so fine. I really enjoyed it.

He had such good tone quality, and like you said before, he played a lot of drive. Well, did you have any sync? He used to do such a beautiful job on tunes like Melancholy Rhapsody. I couldn't wait to hear it every night.
Because he made that with the Basin Street Six. Yeah, right. Which, how did that one too?

I'd like to get another copy of that little, you know, I just cracked my little EP on that Basin Street Six. Oh, really? That Melancholy Rhapsody. I cracked my little 45 on that. And I don't think I'm going to be able to get another one.
Well, Harvey Rubin may be able to make a, or Laz Muscat may be able to make you a copy, because they've got all the equipment hooked up to copy deals.
Well, I have it on, I have it on a cassette. Yeah, that's what I'm talking about. I have it on a cassette. But my little 45 that I made my cassettes from, I cracked my 45.
